password.description: Temporary password: the technician phone number (62... or 0... format)

code.description: Single-use enrollment code from the admin dashboard

public_key.description: The watch public key: base64 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (Android PublicKey.getEncoded()). EC P-256 or RSA 2048+

signature.description: Base64 signature made with the private key over: "enroll", "v1", the code exactly as sent here, and the public key SHA-256 fingerprint, joined by newlines. Proves the watch holds the private key

code.description: The `code` value from the scanned watch QR payload

technician-bearer.description: Technician session token from POST /technician-auth/login or a watch pairing exchange. A watch session also needs the X-Device-Id, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce and X-Signature headers (generate them with the device simulator)
